status: mechanics-guided proposed revision; not battle validated or globally optimized

methodology.positive_affinity_source: Green troop icons in November 26 screenshots; previous ability references used for named effects, current screenshots take precedence over conflicting historical affinity records.
methodology.objective: Preserve eight functioning candidate layouts; test two reserve substitutions, match troop affinity, prioritize persistent stars/habits and distinct roles; seasonal readiness separately.
constraints: no repeated dragons among ten marches
all three dragons have positive affinity for assigned troop type
do not count locked star-gated effects as active
methodology.limitations: No controlled current-reign combat results, equipped item data, troop stock or calibrated simulator. Displayed sums are not measured combat strength or actual filled troops. No claim of mathematical optimum.

marches.evidence: Keep. Dawnseeker Tactical Inferno 5 and Unbroken Devotion 5 support Syrax 2-star and Jagadrix 7-star (Whispering Sabotage 5). Jagadrix Second Wind applies self Nullify Recovery after round 6; watch targeting. Syrax 6-star Recovery locked.

Keep. Solstryker and Antares now 5-star with second habits; Zivern 6-star Tactical vulnerability and Antares Vulnerable complement Solstryker's conditional even-round Tactical hits. No guaranteed proc.

marches.evidence: Keep. Vaeldra 6-star Tempting Distraction 1 makes Taunt targets take more non-basic Physical and Fire damage; Rhysarion Ebbing Fury 3 suppresses both sides early and heals on round 4. Bevlorin 5-star 6-star heal locked.
Keep. Arulix Hypnotic Helix 4 provides Overwhelm/Stagger, Battle Cunning 1 reduces enemy stats; Thunderstrike Battle Rush 5 and Dragon's Might 2 retain Physical pressure. No confirmed team heal.

marches.evidence: Keep. Nyrena Mindful Synergy 2 and Battle Dread 2 buff allies/suppress enemies; Shadowrend and Arrax now 5-star, Arrax Headlong Into Danger 3. All three are level 1 this reign; develop before demanding fights.

Trial: replace Vhagar with Crimson and put Crimson in Vanguard. Its documented odd-round Stun chance enables a qualifying Alicent control trigger if Beacon is unlocked; Crimson Cunning plus Daemoros Willful cover both traits. Tashix contributes Enervate and Dragon's Cunning. Loses Vhagar Taunt and former Tashix Vanguard right-flank bonus; compare original, not guaranteed improvement.

Trial: replace Moondancer with Tairax. Burning Ward's 25% odd-round Stagger chance and Fire/Burn add control; Velar 4-star Quick Reflexes 1 and Vesper 5-star Tactical support retained. Loses Crescent Blade/Rising Tide synergy; retain original as defensive alternate. Tairax Sunder locked until 4-star.

marches.role: Physical finish, Protect and multi-target Fire
marches.evidence: Keep. Vermithor Protect and Noble Sacrifice 1 support Venator 3-star and Caraxes 2-star Battle Dread 1. Caraxes level 1 is a current-reign bottleneck; train before difficult fights. No six-star Legendary enhancements active.
Keep. Kalspire 3-star Robust Insight 1 and Vermax 4-star Reactive Instincts 1 strengthen the existing Feskar 4-star tactical/Physical suppression trio. Kalspire 6-star enhancement locked.

validation_plan: Record combat mode, game version, roster date, equipment and reign levels
Record opponent troop type, dragons, star/habit levels and starting troop counts
Compare troop survival percentage, opposing troops removed, outcome and stalemate/round limit
Note activation of control, Recovery and star-gated effects
Do not reuse pre-September-20 battle reports as if they measured this configuration
